changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 1.0.94[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Maintenance[/COLOR]
-New Maintenance section at the end of Settings, with everything that keeps the add-on light in one place: see what it takes up on the device, Clean up now, automatic cleanup and the Clear options.
-luc_kodi now tidies up after itself. When you leave the add-on it releases the source lists kept in memory, expired source results and temporary files, and checks what it has left on the device.
-Artwork not shown for 1, 3 or 7 days, and the oldest artwork above a storage limit, is removed. The limit is set from the device storage (4%, between 400 MB and 2 GB, halved when the device runs short of space) or chosen by hand. Anything shown in the last two hours is never touched, and picture quality is never lowered.
-Choose how it works: Ask me when there is something worth freeing (default), Automatically in the background, or Off. If Kodi is closed with a cleanup pending, it is finished after the next start.
-The monthly cache tidy-up now also gives back the empty space inside the databases, and the add-on log is emptied when it grows beyond 10 MB. Your history, progress, lists, likes, learned source ranking and settings are never touched.
[COLOR fffdb515]TV Networks[/COLOR]
-TV Shows > Networks goes from 105 entries to 29, chosen by measuring every network: only networks with series airing now that people actually watch and that have sources to play. Streaming first, then the main US networks and cable channels, the UK channels and AT-X for seasonal anime.
-New: Paramount+ and MGM+. Renamed services keep their older series: HBO Max also covers Max, Paramount+ covers CBS All Access, MGM+ covers Epix and AMC covers AMC+.
-Networks picked for precaching that are no longer in the list are dropped, and old picks move to the network that now includes them. The full catalog refresh has 76 fewer lists to load.
-New Tools > Test TV networks: checks every network against TMDb (series, series airing in the last two years, well-known ones) and flags closed networks or wrong IDs. The report is shown on screen, saved as network_audit.txt and written to kodi.log.
[COLOR fffdb515]PunchPlay[/COLOR]
-New sections in the PunchPlay folders of Movies and TV Shows: Collection, Favourites and My Ratings, the same as on your punchplay.tv profile.
-Collection shows each title once, even when you own it in several formats or seasons, and My Ratings lists the movies and shows you have rated.
[COLOR fffdb515]Sources[/COLOR]
-Titles without an IMDb ID can now be searched by the providers that need one (AIOStreams, Torrentio, Comet, Torz, MediaFusion, Peerflix and others): the ID is looked up in TMDb and, for series, in TheTVDB before the search starts.
-The log now shows why AIOStreams discarded each source (title, language, undesirables, seeders), with example names and the title it was looking for.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-The automatic cleanup of unused artwork never removed anything, because Kodi rejected the request it made. Maintenance now does this job.
-TheTVDB and TVmaze artwork is now counted in "See what it takes up on this device" and cleaned like the rest.
-AIOStreams no longer sends a search with an empty ID when no IMDb ID can be found.
